units.source_text: 《法华经》提婆达多品云：“又女人身犹有五障：

en.t: The Devadatta chapter of the Lotus Sutra says, "Moreover, a woman's body still has five hindrances:

units.source_text: 一者不得做梵天王，二者帝释，三者魔王，

en.t: first, she cannot become King Brahma; second, Indra; third, the king of demons;

units.source_text: 四者转轮圣王，五者佛身。”

en.t: fourth, a wheel-turning sage king; and fifth, the body of a Buddha."

units.source_text: 又《大日经》疏云：“修道五障，谓烦恼障、业障、生障、法障、正为所知障也。”

en.t: The commentary on the Mahavairocana Sutra also says, "The five hindrances in cultivating the path are the hindrance of afflictions, the hindrance of karma, the hindrance of birth, the hindrance of dharmas, and, properly speaking, the hindrance to what is to be known."
